note: Value maps: grey = place on the zone dye's 4-stop ramp (0 dark, 0.40 mid, 0.75 light, 1.0 accent; peoples_dyes.json ramps, cloth2 palette tv_*). Motifs: RGB = coverage of three thread dyes over the zone's ground dye. Our own strokes and straight-cut marks; painted with numpy (no photographs, no sheet pixels).

weave.use: homespun cotton and hemp cloth: vests, robes, trousers, skirts, panels

hemp.use: coarse undyed hemp: leg wraps, fringe strips, ties

felt.use: felted wool and heavy cloth: mantles, oath robes

fur.use: goat fur: ruffs and shaggy edges

straw.use: woven split cane and straw: baskets, hats

cord.use: twisted cord and braid: cords, tassels

metal.use: cast bronze, gold and silver: discs, fittings, pins

bone.use: bone, tooth and horn: beads, teeth, pins

feather.use: hawk feather card (value in RGB, the vane in A)

band_motif.use: Mountain Folk woven band: ridge zigzags, stepped terraces, a ladder of journeys; on a madder ground

quilting.use: the imperial levy coat's quilting lattice and stitches

house_mark.use: Stone Children guild band: a straight-cut maker's mark in rows

tide_scroll.use: Dragon-Sea stacked arcs (one ring form; no swirl)
